definitions.explanation: The state of a country or society while a war is going on, with the controls, shortages and hardships that come with it. It usually describes life on the home front rather than the fighting itself.

examples.japanese: {戦時下|せんじか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{暮|く}らし→暮らし：02670_kurashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{苦|くる}しかった→苦しい：02636_kurushii⟧。
⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{戦時下|せんじか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{少女|しょうじょ}→少女：03233_shoujo⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ごした→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother spent her girlhood in wartime.

examples.japanese: {戦時下|せんじか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{配給|はいきゅう}→配給：07881_haikyuu⟧⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}えなかった→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: Under wartime conditions food was rationed, and even rice could not be bought freely.

notes:
〜{下|か} means under a condition or authority, as in {占領下|せんりょうか} (under occupation) and {統制下|とうせいか} (under control).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {戦時下|せんじか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧: Japan in wartime
- {戦時下|せんじか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ / ⟦{暮|く}らし→暮らし：02670_kurashi⟧: life in wartime
- {戦時下|せんじか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to be at war

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{戦時中|せんじちゅう}→戦時中：28629_senjichuu⟧: during the war — the commoner everyday word, used mainly of the Second World War
- ⟦{戦時|せんじ}→戦時：12980_senji⟧: wartime (as opposed to peacetime), mostly in compounds
